name: Polite Turtle 80
author: cosnametv
description: Gradient dark pill green toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background changes from linear-gradient(to right, #2e2e2e, #4a4a4a) to linear-gradient(to right, #66bb6a, #43a047), transform becomes translateX(40px), background-color changes from linear-gradient(to right, #2e2e2e, #4a4a4a) to #66bb6a.
